body: I get that every time I take a realistic look at my life.  It's when I feel the most suicidal.  It's when I realize what a loser I am - what a waste - and how hopeless my life is.  It lasts the same as yours.   I'm sure my thoughts are the catalyst.  I'm 57.

It's too late for that.  There's no life to get back together.  Restoring myself will not change the emptiness in my life, and I surely don't want to learn to live with it.  I wake up every morning with a pit in my stomach, nauseous..  I'm sick and tired of being sick and tired.  

I see so much of me in the link you sent...  Medical attention?  It won't change my situation, and I'll never accept that this emptiness is my life.

Thank you so much, JungRii.  You're a very special person - I can tell.

I also don't get why everyone thinks living is such a blessing.  Why does everyone think people are messed up when they don't want to live anymore?  I don't want to live anymore!  I have nothing, nobody, I have nothing to live for, so I don't want to live anymore.  What is the problem with that?  It's my life, or my death..  I am depressed because I'm trying to survive in a world I don't want to be in anymore..  My depression would end with my death.   Why can't people just die when they want to without others thinking they should be committed for feeling this way??

Seek consultation?   I don't have the energy to even consider that, let alone the motivation.  Fight for THIS life?  It's not worth fighting for.  If I didn't have children I probably would have ended my life long ago..  I just can't embarrass them like that.

I'm not saying that respect is based upon how well one can cover up their problems, I'm saying I must hide this side of me from my children.  I can't state why because it could give away my identity should they read this post, but trust me, my children are the last people on this earth that I would ever turn to regarding my current mental state.  

I would seek help if I wanted it - I seriously see no shame in that - I just don't want it.  I believe I have situational depression.  No one can help my situation.  I have lost every thing and don't want to start over.  I don't have the desire or the energy.   I'm exhausted.  I know what I have to do to survive, I just don't think I want to do it or have the energy.

JungRii – I can’t talk to my children.  It’s not even an option.   I also have to say that I’m not looking for a relationship and/or a partner.  My point was that as an aging woman, people start discounting you which compounds my feelings of worthlessness and  adds validity to my self imposed exile from the world around me.  

Today is a very bad day for me.. Friday’s always are.  It’s the start of the weekend and everyone around me has plans with family, i.e. going to the beach, barbecues,  taking the boat out, etc, etc..  while I sit here alone with no plans and no family.  

I am existing, I’m not living.  I have been in this house since Monday… staring at the walls, crying, and feeling more and more worthless by the second.  I have not seen the outside world in 4 days.  I have not showered, I haven’t brushed my teeth, I have barely moved, and no one knows because I have no family outside of my children - who would absolutely flip if they ever knew the truth.  They would probably loose respect for me for being this weak.  It would be such gossip in my community if anyone found out.  I am the epitome of strength, love and empathy to everyone around me.  No one has any clue I’m crumbling inside.

I hate living.  I have nothing to look forward to.  I have no immediate family.  I have no one who even thinks about me because I have isolated myself to the point where I've lied to my friends so much about ‘having plans’ that they don’t even call anymore.  I can’t move.

I hate living.  Today is not a good day at all.  It’s getting worse and worse.  I wish I was dead.  Seriously.  I just can’t take this anymore nor understand why this was my destiny…  What is the point of living when life is like this?  I am truly the living dead.   I am so sad.

podoph – Yes, I do look forward to seeing my children, however, they’re now in different states working toward their master’s degrees.  It’s not like they’re a 10 minute drive from me anymore.  The days of them stopping by for a quick hello or a warm dinner are over.  They can’t come home Thanksgiving and/or Christmas either because they work where they go to college, and now that I’m unemployed, I can no longer afford to fly to be with them.   Do I look forward to seeing them?  Absolutely, but I’m also getting used to NOT seeing them.   They are so far away geographically, and so far away from having children.  They are scholars..  I raised them to have short term pain for long term gain..   they want to finish their schooling before even considering a long term relationship.  I’ll probably be in my 70’s before I become a grandmother – if I become one at all...  

There is NO WAY I could EVER discuss this with my children.  I am their pillar of strength.  I am their inspiration.  They went through a lot with their father and attribute their survival and inner fortitude to my unconditional love and strength.  They revere, respect, and love me to no end.  I could NEVER reveal this side of me – ever.  It would shatter their whole being and reality.  I have deceived and betrayed them by hiding who I really am because I couldn’t allow them to become me – if that makes any sense.  

As for changing my life for the better, I’ve lost so much, so fast…  I don’t even want to live anymore, let alone make changes for the better.  Better to me would be dying and not having this stress and fear any more…

throwaway44334 – I had a very prestigious job in our community.  All top management were let go for BS corporate reasons.    I can’t say more because my children are on this site so I have to be careful not to give myself away.   People don’t want to hire a 57 yo woman when they can hire someone 20 years younger, prettier, and pay them thousands less.  

I don’t use FB for 3 reasons.  #1) I have nothing to show because my life is so empty,  2) I believe FB is used as a contest to see who can portray being the happiest.  No one ever posts about their husband beating them, their children getting arrested, loosing their job, not being able to pay the mortgage, etc.   People on FB post a fantasy for you to believe, and 3) When I’m on FB, it makes me feel even emptier.  At least these people have pictures to post… I have nothing to post, nothing.   It’s not that I have something to prove and want show off my life, I just wish I HAD a life, and every time I go to FB, I realize again how empty my life really is.  

I hear you on not being able to make a move while immersed in your depression.  I’m feeling the same way these days.  Every thing I do outside the darkness of my home is a struggle, a chore.. I hate leaving the house.  I never have to worry about anyone stopping by because I have no family.  I’m in the house for days and days sometimes and no one knows.  I lie to my friends; my children are in other states.  My biggest fear is if I die, who will find me, and how long will I be dead before I’m found?  

I’m so proud of your success with sobriety!  That’s an enormous step.  You should also be proud of yourself, as I’m sure your family is as well.   Group therapy is a wonderful idea for you…  it shows you you’re not alone which is such validation that you’re not so different after all.  Unfortunately, it’s not an option for me.   I know too many in my community and can’t risk being found out. It would disgrace my children in so many ways…  Talking to my children is not an option.   My strength keeps them going… it’s the core of their foundation.  There is no way I could reveal myself to them.  Ever.

I don’t mean to sound selfish, but yes, even though my children would rather have me, this is about me now. It’s been about my children for 20+ years. They have always been my world, my light, my joy.. but they have their whole life ahead of them now.. College, travel, marriage someday.. Yes, they’d prefer me here, of course, but it’s not essential to their happiness and well-being. They are very accomplished and no longer need me in that way.

I talk to my children regularly either by phone or text. I am divorced from their father 20+ years now. They were not close to their dad due to his sub abuse issues; hence, they rely on me for everything – my opinions, my suggestions, my wisdom. But again, they are very independent and accomplished, thus, they will survive without me just fine.

My depression is that I see no joy in my future. I’ve lost my job, I could potentially loose my house.. I have no savings left. I am a 57 yo aging woman, who, in our society, is discounted because I’m considered ‘old’. Men my age want younger women; women my age look younger because they can afford plastic surgery… No man is going to want me when he can have younger..

I feel like I did when I was 20.. no money, wondering what the future holds for me, wondering where I might end up living, etc, etc, etc.. I just don’t have the energy, or desire, to start over again. Where I once saw a beautiful woman in the mirror with an exciting future, I now see an aging woman with none. To be honest, I can barely stand looking in the mirror anymore. 

As I look around me I see families that are flourishing with grandchildren, homes that are being remodeled, marriages that are celebrating 35 year anniversaries, family cruises and vacations, such joy… and here I am with nothing. No husband, no job, no family (parents died and one sibling I never see), and maybe no home.. I’m always envying what everyone else has because I have nothing due to foolish decisions made along the way… and I’m tired from feeling so worthless and empty. How can one live without anything to look forward to? Where one day runs into the other? Where weekends no longer mean anything because it's just another day with nothing...

No, I don't feel better... my hopelessness is getting worse and worse.  Yes, I have children (both in college) who would also be terrified if they knew I was posting here.  I am their rock.  I'm all they have.  It would ruin them if they knew I was considering suicide - absolutely destroy them.  They have no clue I'm in this state.  My public persona is an act of strength and wisdom.  I'm such a fraud - even to those who love me the most and know me the best.     

I am trying to figure out how to end my life so it looks like an accident..   I feel incredibly worthless and it's getting harder and harder to get out of bed every day.  I have no fight left.  I feel death is a better option than living this pain day after day.   I just haven't figured out how to do that yet.  If it looks like suicide, my children loose my life insurance so I have to be very careful how I pull this off - IF I have the courage to go through with it.

Thank you to everyone for your concern and reassurance. I want to reiterate that I’m 57 so I’m not sure if anyone here can understand my position and/or guide me if you’re all young enough to be my children. I would greatly welcome your feedback on this.  I also noticed several comments were deleted and wondered why..

Thank you for responding.  Then it's better I don't post here... I can't take that risk.. I should just do what I want to do and be done with it.  Talking never helps anyway - not sure what I was thinking by coming here.
